title: Segment Disclosure Transparency and Internal Capital Market Efficiency: Evidence from SFAS No. 131

scopes.description: Reproduce the author-documented results in online appendix Tables A1–A11; the supplied release contains only the appendix PDF and does not identify an executable workflow.

requirements.description: Author-compatible analysis inputs and construction inputs needed to reproduce Appendix Tables A1–A11. The release does not identify the complete products, fields, identifiers, periods, coverage, or transformations; the appendix alone does not establish a usable analysis-data route.

issues.description: The frozen package inventory contains only cho_online_appendix.pdf. It contains reported tables and descriptions, but no executable author program or run instructions; therefore there is no supplied entry point to attempt.

The appendix presents results, selected variable definitions, and some source references, but does not establish the complete preparation/analysis workflow, input schema, identifiers, full coverage, or stage order for Tables A1–A11. Those references may describe historical provenance or prepared data rather than live inputs; dependency closure and compatible analysis-data routes remain unknown.

actions.description: Request the complete author-provided workflow or an explicitly approved replacement description, plus its compatible data inputs, to establish how Tables A1–A11 are produced.
steps: Obtain the executable author programs or the approved replacement workflow, including entry points, required preparation stages, and stage order for every reported table.
Obtain the author-prepared analysis inputs or exact input contracts: source products/files, fields, identifiers, sample period and coverage, transformations, and expected format.

Clarify whether the appendix’s references to historical source fields and breakpoint data are dependencies of the supplied workflow or describe provenance already embodied in author-prepared analysis data.
After the workflow and inputs are documented, map each mandatory source and generated intermediate before assessing a run attempt.
validation: Confirm that the supplied workflow accounts for every Appendix Table A1–A11 and that each mandatory input has a compatible verified route or a separately recorded unresolved gap.

review_notes: This assessment covers the frozen package variant whose only inventoried artifact is the online appendix PDF. No author code or author-prepared analysis dataset is present, so no analysis-only scope is supported.

The appendix’s selected source and variable references are retained as context; without the author workflow they do not establish mandatory live raw-data dependencies. The complete input set and producer workflow remain unknown rather than reconstructed.
No author program was executed, no dataset was read or downloaded, and no software requirement can be established from the supplied release.
